patch_description: Apply the recommended hybrid composition. The current program already implements the volatility-scheduled Kalman + RTS + percentile-blended multi-scale SG pipeline (Gen 45/46 lineage). What's missing to combine their strengths is: (1) a confidence-gated trend lead applied to the *already-SG-smoothed* slope channel (computed from the polished level, not the raw RTS slope), which reduces lag_error without injecting slope noise; (2) a short second-cascade SG pass that kills residual ripple and drives down false_reversals/slope_changes at negligible trend distortion. The sigmoid gate keeps quiet regions untouched (smoothness) while advancing statistically significant trends (responsiveness), targeting the lag/smoothness trade-off frontier that no program has broken past 0.65 on.
